title: Reorder List
summary: Rewire a singly linked list so its nodes appear in the order first, last, second, second-last, and so on.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–50,000 nodes with values in [1, 1,000]. The list has no cycle. For odd lengths, the middle node appears once at the end.

statement: Rewire a singly linked list so its nodes appear in the order first, last, second, second-last, and so on. Keep the first node as the head and leave each node's value intact. Implement a procedure that returns no value. The judge follows the original head afterward to read the reordered list.

examples.explanation: The original middle node 3 ends the reordered list.
The result alternates from the two ends.
The only node stays in place.

constraints: 1–50,000 nodes with values in [1, 1,000]. The list has no cycle. For odd lengths, the middle node appears once at the end.
hints: Conceptual: The output alternates between the front and back of the original order.
Directional: Split the list near its midpoint and reverse the second part.
Implementation: Detach the halves before reversing. Weave them together by alternating one node from each, saving both successors before rewiring.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space with an in-place split, reversal and weave.
